mergedParams.userDescription: Simple text with a smooth, buttery ease-in-out on all movements. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

prompts.prompt: Create a typography kinetics preset that implements a classic 'butter-smooth' animation system where each text element flows in with luxurious ease-in-out curves. Think of this like a high-end motion graphics package where text doesn't just appear - it glides into frame with the sophistication of premium video titles. Each word should have a subtle overshoot at the end of its movement (like After Effects' Easy Ease with a touch of bounce), creating that satisfying 'settling' feeling. The text should scale from 0.85 to 1.0 while simultaneously fading in from opacity 0 to 1, with a slight blur-to-sharp transition (5px to 0px blur). Stagger the animation of each word with a 100ms delay between them, creating a cascading reveal effect. The entire animation should feel like pouring honey - smooth, continuous, and satisfying to watch.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full' as containerProps.className. For caption-based typography, iterate through captionData.words array and create individual TextAtom components for each word. Apply a generic keyframe effect to each TextAtom with AnimationRange for opacity (0 to 1), scale (0.85 to 1), and custom filter for blur (blur(5px) to blur(0px)). Use 'cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)' for the ease-in-out curve. Set animation duration to 800ms per word with staggered start times using word.relativeStart + (index * 0.1). Add 'transform-gpu will-change-transform' to each TextAtom's className for GPU acceleration. Consider using an internal effect preset called 'butter-smooth-reveal' that combines these transformations for reusability across multiple text elements.

prompts.prompt: Design a minimalist kinetic typography preset focused on pure translational movement with butter-smooth easing. Imagine editing a sleek corporate video where text slides in from off-screen edges with perfect timing. Each line of text should enter from alternating sides (left, right, left, right) creating a dynamic zigzag reading pattern. The movement should be purely horizontal translation with no rotation or scale changes - just clean, confident slides. Use a custom ease-in-out curve that starts slow, accelerates smoothly through the middle 60% of the animation, then decelerates gently to rest. Add a subtle shadow that intensifies as the text settles into position, giving depth without complexity. The timing should breathe - give each line 1.2 seconds to complete its journey with 200ms overlap between consecutive lines.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' as containerProps.className. Parse caption data into sentences and create child BaseLayout containers for each with 'absolute w-full' positioning. Apply translateX effects starting from -100% (left entries) or 100% (right entries) animating to 0. Use 'ease-in-out' easing with spring tension for natural deceleration. Add dynamic textShadow effect progressing from '0 0 0 transparent' to '2px 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)' synchronized with the translation. Each sentence container should have 'flex items-center' with justify-start for left entries and justify-end for right entries. Set fitDurationTo: 'children' on the parent to accommodate all animations. Consider implementing as a sub-preset that accepts 'direction' parameter for reusable left/right sliding components.

prompts.prompt: Build an organic, fluid typography preset where text appears to be written by an invisible hand with smooth, continuous motion. Think of it as recreating the feel of hand-lettered titles in a documentary, but with digital precision. Each character should reveal through a clip-path animation that follows a natural writing path - left to right for Latin text. The 'ink' should flow at a variable speed: faster through straight segments, slower through curves and transitions between words. Layer this with a subtle opacity fade (0.3 to 1) that trails slightly behind the clip-path reveal, creating a sense of the ink settling onto the page. Add micro-movements - a tiny 1-2px vertical float that continues even after the text is fully revealed, giving it a living, breathing quality.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' and create TextAtom components for each word. Implement clip-path animation using CSS custom properties in containerProps.style, animating from 'polygon(0 0, 0 0, 0 100%, 0 100%)' to 'polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%)'. Create a two-stage effect: first the clip-path reveal over 600ms with 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1)' easing, then a subtle translateY oscillation using a looped effect from 0 to -2px with 'ease-in-out' over 3000ms. Stack effects array with both the reveal and the float. Use word.relativeStart to stagger reveals naturally. Add 'transform-gpu will-change-clip-path' for performance. Consider creating an internal 'handwritten-reveal' effect preset that handles the clip-path progression with customizable duration and direction parameters.

prompts.prompt: Develop a sophisticated word-by-word emphasis preset where each word scales and brightens individually as if being spoken by a narrator, with buttery smooth transitions between states. Imagine a TED talk video where key words pulse with importance. The base state should be at 0.9 scale with 0.7 opacity. As each word's timing arrives (based on caption data), it should smoothly scale to 1.1, brighten to full opacity, and add a subtle glow effect, then ease back to a resting state of 1.0 scale with 0.85 opacity. The transition should use a smooth bell curve - accelerating into the emphasis, holding briefly at peak, then decelerating out. Create a subtle color shift during emphasis - from neutral gray to pure white to slight warmth (off-white) as it settles.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 px-8' as containerProps.className. Generate TextAtom for each word in captionData.words. Create a three-phase keyframe effect for each word: rest state (scale: 0.9, opacity: 0.7), emphasis state (scale: 1.1, opacity: 1, filter: 'drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.5))'), and settled state (scale: 1.0, opacity: 0.85). Use word.relativeStart as the trigger time with 400ms for rise, 200ms hold, and 400ms for settle. Apply 'transition-all duration-400 ease-in-out' as base className. Implement color progression from 'rgb(200,200,200)' through 'rgb(255,255,255)' to 'rgb(255,252,248)'. Consider using word.metadata.impact to vary the emphasis intensity - higher impact words get 1.15 scale and stronger glow.

prompts.prompt: Create a smooth elastic typography preset where text behaves like it's attached to soft springs, gently bouncing into place with momentum-based physics. Picture editing a playful brand video where text doesn't just appear - it arrives with personality. Each word should drop in from above with acceleration due to 'gravity', overshoot its target position by 10-15%, bounce back up slightly (5%), then settle with a final micro-bounce (1-2%). The horizontal position should also have a subtle sway, as if the text is hanging from invisible strings. Time the bounces using realistic physics intervals: initial drop 500ms, first bounce 200ms, second bounce 150ms, final settle 100ms. Add rotation that corresponds to the vertical movement - tilting forward on the drop, backward on the bounce.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' and position words absolutely. Create spring-based animation using multiple keyframe ranges: translateY from -200% to 15% (overshoot), back to -5% (bounce), to 2% (micro-bounce), finally to 0. Simultaneously animate rotation from -5deg to 3deg to -1deg to 0. Use 'cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)' for elastic easing on the initial drop, then 'ease-out' for bounces. Add subtle translateX sway: animate from 0 to 2% to -1% to 0 over the same timeline. Apply 'absolute transform-gpu will-change-transform' to each TextAtom. Stagger words by 150ms using word.relativeStart offset. Consider implementing physics-based timing calculations in presetExecution for realistic bounce intervals based on 'drop height' parameter.

prompts.prompt: Design a liquid morphing typography preset where text flows between states like viscous fluid, with perfectly smooth transitions that feel organic and continuous. Imagine creating titles for a luxury perfume commercial where elegance is paramount. Text should initially appear blurred and stretched horizontally (scaleX: 1.5, scaleY: 0.7), then smoothly morph to normal proportions while the blur clears. Add a subtle wave distortion that ripples through the text during transition - like looking at text through water that's gradually becoming still. The color should shift from translucent (opacity: 0.4) to solid, with a slight iridescent quality achieved through a gradient text effect. Every transition should overlap seamlessly with no hard edges or sudden movements.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'flex items-center justify-center w-full h-full'. Apply complex transform matrices to TextAtom components: initial state with transform: 'scaleX(1.5) scaleY(0.7)', filter: 'blur(8px)'. Animate to scaleX(1) scaleY(1) with blur(0) over 1200ms using 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1)'. Implement wave distortion using custom CSS filter with SVG turbulence that animates from baseFrequency='0.02' to '0'. Add gradient overlay using background-clip: text with linear-gradient animating from 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)' to 'rgba(255,255,255,1)'. Use will-change: 'transform, filter' for optimization. Consider creating a 'liquid-morph' internal effect preset with configurable viscosity and distortion parameters.

prompts.prompt: Build a precision-timed stagger reveal preset where each letter unfolds with Swiss watch accuracy, creating mesmerizing patterns through perfectly calculated delays. Think of editing a high-tech product launch video where every detail matters. Letters should rotate in from a 90-degree fold (like pages in a book) with individual timing offsets creating a wave effect across the text. The fold axis should alternate: odd letters rotate from rotateY(-90deg), even letters from rotateY(90deg). Each letter's animation should be exactly 400ms with a 25ms stagger, creating a total cascade time that's mathematically predictable. Add a subtle brightness pulse that travels through the letters in sequence, separate from but harmonizing with the rotation timing.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'flex items-center justify-center' and create individual span elements for each character using split('').map(). Apply perspective: '1000px' to the parent container for 3D depth. Each letter gets position: 'relative', transform-style: 'preserve-3d', and animates rotateY from ±90deg to 0deg. Implement double-layered timing: rotation effect with 400ms duration and 25ms * index delay, plus brightness filter from 'brightness(0.5)' to 'brightness(1.2)' to 'brightness(1)' with 30ms * index delay. Use 'ease-in-out' for rotation, 'ease-out' for brightness. Add backface-visibility: 'hidden' for clean rotation. Consider parameterizing stagger timing and fold angle for preset customization.

prompts.prompt: Create an atmospheric fade-through preset where text materializes from a soft haze with dreamy, ethereal movements. Picture editing ambient video art where text emerges from and returns to mist. Each word should have three layers of animation: a base fade from 0 to 1 opacity, a subtle scale from 0.95 to 1.0 to create a 'focusing' effect, and a soft gaussian blur that clears gradually. Add atmospheric particle-like movements - tiny random translations (±3px horizontal, ±2px vertical) that continue throughout the text's lifetime, as if the words are floating in space. The timing should be languid and hypnotic - 2 full seconds per word with 500ms overlaps creating a continuous flow of appearing text.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Create TextAtom components with initial state: opacity: 0, transform: 'scale(0.95)', filter: 'blur(20px)'. Animate to opacity: 1, scale(1), blur(0) over 2000ms using 'cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)'. Layer a secondary infinite animation for float effect: use transform: 'translate(calc(var(--float-x) * 1px), calc(var(--float-y) * 1px))' with CSS custom properties set to random values between -3 and 3. Update float values every 3000ms with 'ease-in-out' transition. Apply backdrop-filter: 'blur(2px)' to container for atmospheric depth. Consider using noise functions in presetExecution to generate organic float patterns rather than pure random movement.

prompts.prompt: Develop a momentum-conserving carousel preset where text rotates into view along a circular path, maintaining smooth angular velocity throughout. Imagine editing a dynamic sports highlight reel where energy never stops. Words should travel along an elliptical orbit, starting from behind (z: -100px, opacity: 0) and rotating forward into the viewing plane, continuing past, then fading out. The movement should feel like a Ferris wheel - constant angular speed but with perspective changes making distant text smaller and near text larger. Each word follows the previous with precise timing gaps, creating an endless stream effect. Add subtle motion blur during the fastest movement sections (sides of the ellipse) that clears at the apex points.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full perspective-1000'. Position words absolutely at center, then apply circular motion using transform: 'rotateX(angle) translateZ(radius)'. Animate angle from 0deg to 360deg over 3000ms with 'linear' easing for constant angular velocity. Simultaneously animate opacity: 0 to 1 to 0 based on z-position (visible from -45deg to 45deg). Apply dynamic scale based on z-position using calc: 'scale(calc(1 + var(--z-position) * 0.003))'. Add motion blur using filter during side passages (90deg and 270deg): 'blur(0) to blur(2px) to blur(0)'. Stagger each word's animation-delay by 300ms. Consider implementing elliptical path calculations for more complex orbital patterns.

prompts.prompt: Design a breath-synchronized typography preset where text expands and contracts with organic rhythm, like words are being gently breathed onto the screen. Think of meditative video content where calmness is key. Each word should scale rhythmically from 0.98 to 1.02 and back, with opacity pulsing from 0.9 to 1.0 in sync. The 'breathing' cycle should be approximately 4 seconds - 2 seconds inhale (expand), 2 seconds exhale (contract). Layer multiple words with offset phases so the entire text block seems to undulate naturally. Add a subtle vertical drift - words slowly rise 5-10px over their lifetime, like warm air ascending. The key is making all movements feel connected and biological, never mechanical.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3 px-6'. Create TextAtom components with base animation loop: scale from 0.98 to 1.02, opacity from 0.9 to 1.0, using 'cubic-bezier(0.445, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95)' for natural breathing curve. Set animation duration to 4000ms with infinite loop. Phase offset each word using (index * 0.15) seconds delay to create wave effect. Add slow vertical drift: translateY from 0 to -10px over 20000ms with 'linear' easing. Apply transform-origin: 'center bottom' for natural expansion point. Use CSS custom properties for breath-intensity and breath-speed parameters. Consider implementing sine wave calculations in presetExecution for perfectly smooth respiratory cycles.
